statements.__comment: ElastiCache nodes never get a public address and are reachable only from inside their VPC, so a cluster is never internet exposed, whatever its security groups allow. This job only clears flags written by earlier versions that matched open security groups.
statements.query: MATCH (cluster:ElasticacheCluster)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AWSAccount{id: $AWS_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:AWSOrganization{id: $ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE cluster.exposed_internet IS NOT NULL OR cluster.exposed_internet_type IS NOT NULL OR cluster.publicContext IS NOT NULL WITH cluster LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE REMOVE cluster.exposed_internet, cluster.exposed_internet_type, cluster.publicContext return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted
